definitions.gloss: autumn leaf viewing; maple leaf viewing
definitions.explanation: The activity of going out to view autumn foliage, especially maple leaves.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}に{紅葉狩|もみじが}りに{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go autumn leaf viewing in fall.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{紅葉狩|もみじが}りを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed autumn leaf viewing with friends.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}は{紅葉狩|もみじが}りの{名所|めいしょ}だ。
examples.english: Kyoto is a famous spot for autumn leaf viewing.

examples.japanese: {紅葉狩|もみじが}りで{山|やま}を{散策|さんさく}するのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like strolling in the mountains for autumn leaf viewing.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{紅葉狩|もみじが}りに{出|で}かけて、{赤|あか}や{黄色|きいろ}に{色|いろ}づいた{山|やま}の{景色|けしき}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We went out with the family for autumn leaf viewing and enjoyed the mountain scenery colored in red and yellow.

notes:
{紅葉狩|もみじが}り is a traditional autumn activity in Japan, similar to {花見|はなみ} (cherry blossom viewing) in spring.

WORD ORIGIN:
{狩|か}り originally meant "hunting" but evolved to mean "viewing" or "enjoying" nature.

SEASON:
Typically enjoyed from late October through November, depending on the region.
